name: Groq
summary: Groq inference for open models, distinct from xAI/Grok. Organization rate limits can constrain requests below nominal context size.

credentials.label: Groq API key
credentials.help: Use your own GroqCloud organization API key, not an xAI/Grok key.

setupSteps.title: Open the Groq Console
setupSteps.description: Create your own API key manually for the intended organization.

setupSteps.title: Check Free or Developer tier
setupSteps.description: Check organization billing and exact model RPM/TPM limits. A large context window does not override rate limits.

setupSteps.title: Add a pinned model route
setupSteps.description: Use the exact OpenAI-compatible base URL and a concrete GPT-OSS model. Paid fallback requires deliberate configuration.
